purpose: Diagnostic only -- tier reveal and disagreement analysis. No methodology, weight, anchor, or code change performed in this pass.
canonical_score_source_rule: Targeted PASS A rerun result where one exists (Oscar Health, Quibi, Stripe, Tesla Motors, Ginkgo Bioworks, Instacart, Warby Parker), otherwise the original PASS A result. In practice this means app/calibration/v2/pass_a/targeted_rerun/aggregate_results.json is the canonical source for all 15 companies, since that file already contains the original values for every company it did not revise.
provenance_ordering: CRITICAL: all 15 companies' SPS, pillar scores, dimension scores, coverage, and confidence values were finalized and written to disk in app/calibration/v2/pass_a/ and app/calibration/v2/pass_a/targeted_rerun/ BEFORE this PASS B step ran. expected_quality_tier was read for the first time only in this PASS B step, via a script that extracted ONLY the expected_quality_tier field (never future_outcome, never benchmark_notes) using the manifest's set==calibration filter -- the same allowlist discipline as blind_loader.py, applied in reverse (reveal tier only, keep outcome blind). No score was regenerated, adjusted, or re-derived after tier reveal.
not_inspected: any holdout company record (Fab.com, Rdio, Homejoy, DoorDash, Zenefits)
not_performed_in_pass_b: any change to production scoring code
any change to PASS A or targeted-PASS-A-rerun results
tier_extraction_method: python3 script reading app/benchmarks/manifest.json to filter set=="calibration", then loading only expected_quality_tier from each of the 15 corresponding app/benchmarks/companies/*.json files. Holdout files were never opened.
